Albemarle Announces CEO Succession Plan
We transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health.

Mobility We play a fundamental role in advancing the future of mobility on the road, in the air and in orbit—from critical materials that power battery systems, to safety components like airbag initiators, and more.
Energy We support the build-out of energy storage systems that help power data centers and ensure a more reliable grid.
Connectivity We enhance safety and reliability in connections, from fire safety compounds in electronics, wires and cables to the protective glass on phones.
Health We produce specialty chemicals and additives for medicines, disinfectants and solutions that keep our food and water safe and plentiful.
Advancing U.S. critical resources and essential elements.​

Including our global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, our U.S. sites help provide a secure supply of essential elements to customers around the world. Throughout the U.S., Albemarle operates world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, a state-of-the-art lithium conversion facility, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities and the U.S.'s only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV.​

A Global Footprint, Built for Reliable Supply

We’re committed to sustainability in all that we do, transparently sharing insights into our sustainability strategy, objectives and accomplishments. Our approach to environmental stewardship, responsible sourcing, community engagement and employee welfare is a daily pursuit across all aspects of our organization.
Our innovative technologies and practices minimize our environmental footprint and ensure a sustainable supply of critical minerals for the future while minimizing our environmental impact today.

We partner to pioneer new ways to move, power, connect and protect. We care for the communities where we operate and the prosperity of future generations.
Albemarle leads the world in transforming essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health.

Mobility We play a fundamental role in advancing the future of mobility on the road, in the air and in orbit—from critical materials that power battery systems, to safety components like airbag initiators, and more.
Energy We support the build-out of energy storage systems that help power data centers and ensure a more reliable grid.
Connectivity We enhance safety and reliability in connections, from fire safety compounds in electronics, wires and cables to the protective glass on phones.
Health We produce specialty chemicals and additives for medicines, disinfectants and solutions that keep our food and water safe and plentiful.
Care • Curiosity • Collaboration • Humility • Accountability • Integrity
View Our Code of Conduct
Our People Work to Shape The Future, Build With Purpose and Grow Together
With more than a century of history in humbly serving both people and planet, Albemarle exists to enable a more resilient world.
We pioneer solutions from mine to market – all while safeguarding people and communities.
Proud of our role in the lives of our employees and in the communities where we live and work.
We’re committed to help build, nurture and celebrate a thriving workforce and vibrant communities.
We Responsibly Manage Resources to Minimize Impact to the Community and Planet

As a signatory to both the UN Global Compact and the UN CEO Water Mandate, we contribute to the nine sustainable development goals to address environmental and social challenges, including poverty, inequality, climate change and environmental degradation.
We work to build and sustain the conditions for long-term value creation and shareholder returns.
Headquartered in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle Corporation (NYSE: ALB), employs approximately 7,800 people worldwide and serves customers in approximately 70 countries.
A Global Footprint, Built for Reliable Supply

raw_blocks: Albemarle has been a pioneer in India for over 20 years, starting with the supply of laboratory and pilot quantities to major organic synthesis projects.

Albemarle’s Global Digital Technology Hub drives innovation and digital transformation to support our global operations. This state-of-the-art facility focuses on advanced technology solutions such as artificial intelligence and digital automation within a globally competitive landscape.

Address: Albemarle Global Digital Technology Hub PS-I, 8th Floor of Tower 2 Sumadhura Capitol Towers, Sy No. 14 & 158 Pattandur Agrahara Village, K.R. Puram Hobli, Bangalore East Taluk, Bangalore – 560066
Albemarle's location in India works with specialty chemical and cesium compounds and collaborates together with research departments as well as CROs (Contract Research Organization).
Address: Albemarle India New Materials Pvt. Ltd. A321, Master Mind 4, Royal Palms, Goregaon (East), Mumbai–400065, Maharashtra, India
